en: city born and bred
context: Often permanent workers were city born and bred (and had received more education and possibly an apprenticeship training),
meaning: 在城里出生长大
current_zh: 固定工往往是城里土生土长的
note: 现译已贴切，无风险。

en: the “corvée”
context: In pre-revolutionary France, the “corvée” the feudal obligation to work for a set period on the King’s highway, was one of the most hated duties imposed on the peasants.
meaning: 法国封建时代农民为王室修路的无偿劳役
current_zh: 这种封建义务叫“徭役”
note: 场景在法国；“徭役”是中国史名词，但通用度高，不算特有典故，可用；想避开中国史色彩可用“劳役”。保留引号表示专名。

en: only too willing
context: The party recognized the political dangers of a division between permanent and temporary workers, with the unscrupulous only too willing to divert the attention of rural workers from employers to their permanent co-workers
meaning: 巴不得、求之不得
current_zh: 总有些不择手段的人乐于挑拨
suggest: 总有些不择手段的人巴不得挑拨
note: “巴不得”更传神，口语但不油滑。

en: a pool of cheap labour
context: The rural workers who came to the city could be used in exactly the same way as immigrants are used in the industrialized countries today—a pool of cheap labour in a boom, and the scapegoat for the failure of the ruling order in conditions of slump
meaning: 可随时取用的廉价劳动力储备
current_zh: 繁荣时是廉价劳动力的蓄水池
note: 现译保留原比喻，中文可接受，无风险。

en: the scapegoat
context: a pool of cheap labour in a boom, and the scapegoat for the failure of the ruling order in conditions of slump
meaning: 代人受过者
current_zh: 萧条时又成了统治秩序失败的替罪羊
note: 中文通行，无风险；p.127 章末“victim and scapegoat”（现译“依旧是受害者和替罪羊”）同此。

en: set them at each other’s throats
context: a tactic excellently designed to divide the opposition and set them at each other’s throats.
meaning: 挑动他们互相争斗、自相残杀
current_zh: 这一招最能分化反抗者，让他们窝里斗。
note: 口语，贬义，对象是被分化的反抗者，力度相当；excellently designed 的冷讽现译用“最能”略有体现。

en: used as a buffer ... in sudden spurts
context: Such workers were not included in the plan estimates for labour, and were used as a buffer by managers and cadres in sudden spurts to meet changes in target deadlines.
meaning: 当作调节余缺的机动力量，指标期限一变就突击调用
current_zh: 管理人员和干部拿他们当缓冲，指标期限一变，就调他们来突击赶工。
suggest: 管理人员和干部拿他们当机动力量，指标期限一变，就调来突击赶工。
note: “缓冲”单用略生硬，可改“机动力量”；“突击赶工”贴切。

en: without questions being asked ... secure a niche in the city
context: illegal immigrants could get work without questions being asked, and so secure a niche in the city.
meaning: 没人追问来历，就此在城里有个立足处
current_zh: 没有合法身份就进了城的人，在这里找活干没人多问，也就能在城里落下脚来。
suggest: 没有合法身份就进了城的人，在这里找活不问来路，也就能在城里落下脚来。
note: 两个习语现译都已处理自然；“不问来路”更点题（非法进城）。

en: to dilute the labour force
context: temporary labour in the People’s Republic was being used systematically to displace permanent workers, to dilute the labour force.
meaning: 英国劳工运动术语 dilution：用非熟练或非正式工替代正式工，降低工人队伍的整体地位
current_zh: 人民共和国是在有系统地用临时工顶替固定工，稀释工人队伍。
suggest: 人民共和国是在有系统地用临时工顶替固定工，冲淡固定工在工人队伍中的分量。
note: “稀释”直译可懂；“掺沙子”是1970年代毛的用语（甩石头、掺沙子、挖墙脚），会带入特定政治联想，不推荐。

en: through the upsurge of the Red Guards
context: Until the end of 1966, through the upsurge of the Red Guards and their assault on all manner of malpractices, in the successive defining rules and documents of the Cultural Revolution, there was no mention of the condition and problems of temporary workers.
meaning: 红卫兵运动高涨
current_zh: 直到1966年底，红卫兵运动风起云涌，向形形色色的弊端开火
note: 现译已用；“风起云涌”带气势、略褒，作者此处中性偏冷，接着就说红卫兵对临时工只字未提，用它反衬也可；拿不准可改平实的“高涨”。

en: In the charged atmosphere of the time
context: In the charged atmosphere of the time, the centre had little alternative but to authorize their reinstatement and the payment of back wages to temporary workers.
meaning: 气氛紧张，一触即发
current_zh: 在当时那种一点就着的气氛里
note: 现译贴切；“剑拔弩张”指双方对峙，场景不完全对。

en: sanctioned the agitation
context: Jiang Qing’s accusation—that it was all the fault of Liu Shaoqi—sanctioned the agitation of Red Guards, Red Rebels and the temporary and contract workers themselves.
meaning: 等于认可、放行了这些鼓动
current_zh: 这就等于给红卫兵、红色造反派以及临时工、合同工自己的鼓动开了绿灯
note: “开绿灯”贴切、中性，无风险。

en: a run on the banks and a spending spree
context: There was a run on the banks and a spending spree.
meaning: 银行挤兑，大肆抢购
current_zh: 接着就出现了银行挤兑和抢购风
note: 现译贴切；“接着”是增补的时序，原文并列，可接受。

en: The line had swung into reverse
context: The line had swung into reverse, but the party had to campaign hard to hold wages stable and to eject workers and students who had returned from the countryside
meaning: 路线来了个反向大转弯
current_zh: 路线已经掉头
suggest: 路线已经来了个大掉头
note: “掉头”可用；“一百八十度”略加强，力度大致相当。

en: relinquish their only hold on power
context: Whatever else, they must relinquish their only hold on power—access to the urban mass.
meaning: 手中唯一能对当权者施加影响的凭借
current_zh: 他们必须交出手里唯一的筹码：接近城市群众的机会。
note: “筹码”贴切；hold on power 不是“权力”本身，现译处理得当。

en: The festival of the oppressed was over
context: The festival of the oppressed was over, but the battles were not.
meaning: 化用列宁“革命是被压迫者的节日”
current_zh: 被压迫者的节日过去了
suggest: 被压迫者的节日过去了
note: 列宁典故（《社会民主党在民主革命中的两种策略》），保留直译，可加译注说明出处；不宜换成中文现成说法。

en: at the first sign of serious change
context: Their resentment at the injustice of being promised a revolution, only to have it snatched away at the first sign of serious change, was no doubt one of the threads in subsequent events.
meaning: 刚出现真正变革的迹象
current_zh: 可刚露出一点真正变革的苗头，革命就被夺走了
note: 现译贴切。

en: one of the threads in subsequent events
context: Their resentment at the injustice of being promised a revolution, only to have it snatched away at the first sign of serious change, was no doubt one of the threads in subsequent events.
meaning: 贯穿此后事件的一条线
current_zh: 他们对这种不公的怨恨，无疑是后来种种事件的线索之一。
suggest: 他们对这种不公的怨恨，无疑是贯穿后来种种事件的一条线。
alt: 后来种种事件的起因之一
note: “线索”在中文多指查案、追查的线索，略有歧义；“暗线”加了“隐伏”义，稍增，只说“一条线”即可。

en: the establishment had closed ranks
context: But officially, the establishment had closed ranks.
meaning: 当权者重新抱团、一致对外
current_zh: 但在官方层面，当权者已经重新抱成一团
note: 现译贴切；“沆瀣一气”贬义过重，不推荐。

en: thrust into the background
context: The cause of the temporary workers was thrust into the background.
meaning: 被撂到一边、冷落
current_zh: 临时工的事被推到了一边。
suggest: 临时工的事被晾在了一边。
note: “晾在一边”带冷落意味，合 thrust；“束之高阁”多指文件、方案，不太合 cause。

en: a microcosm of the Cultural Revolution
context: The campaign on behalf of the temporary workers was a microcosm of the Cultural Revolution.
meaning: 文革的缩影
current_zh: 为临时工鸣不平的这场运动，正是文化大革命的缩影。
note: 现译贴切。

en: flirted with class issues ... drew back in alarm
context: A section of the leadership flirted with class issues in order to destroy its rivals within the party, but drew back in alarm when the issues became a real class war.
meaning: 拿阶级问题当工具摆弄一番，见真打起来就慌忙缩回
current_zh: 领导层里的一派为了打垮党内对手，拿阶级问题做文章，可一旦问题真的变成阶级战争，又惊慌失措地缩了回去。
suggest: 拿阶级问题做文章……又慌忙缩了回去
note: “做文章”贴切；“惊慌失措”比 in alarm 略重，可改“慌忙”。“叶公好龙”意思相近，但会把重点变成“假爱好”，不推荐。

en: win credit
context: Had it been abolished, reduced or radically changed, the government would not have failed to inform the mass of the population through press and radio and thereby win credit for ending such an oppressive feature of employment.
meaning: 借此为自己赢得名声、表功
current_zh: 好为结束这样一种压迫人的用工方式记上一功
note: 现译贴切；“脸上贴金”贬义过重。
